CodeMirror 6 Bundle

codemirror.js is CodeMirror 6 (MIT), bundled from npm with esbuild and vendored unmodified. It defines the global CM. LICENSE.txt lists every package in the bundle with its version and licence.

The bundle was copied on 10 October 2026 from Paul Parks's Parks Computing site, C:/Users/paul/OneDrive/Documents/parkscomputing.com/wwwroot/js/vendor/codemirror-6.43/, where its build is recorded; that copy's SHA-256 is 3071D3A4C947E02CFA48A92E9A85823994BF972916B9F7E3A6306A22029AEC86. The same day it was rebuilt from the same package versions with Decoration and WidgetType added to the exports, for the Editor's suggestions; before the change, the rebuild matched the copied bundle byte for byte. That rebuilt bundle's SHA-256 was 2BC7C9169DE52AD12F9CE12BA557DB5DD41C86EA315388BB7AFB82AC809F1F74.

On 25 October 2026 the bundle was rebuilt again, from the same package versions, with @codemirror/merge 6.12.3 (MIT, by Marijn Haverbeke, CodeMirror's author) added for the Editor's diff view (diff-applet.js): MergeView, unifiedMergeView, getChunks and the rest of that package's exports, together with gutter, GutterMarker, ViewPlugin, Prec and Text from the packages already bundled, the HTML, CSS and JavaScript languages that Markdown had already brought in, and a few of the small stream languages (Go, Python, YAML, Lua, PowerShell, TOML, Rust, XML, SQL, C, C++, C#, Java, properties and Dockerfile). Before the change, the recipe rebuilt the previous bundle byte for byte. The new bundle's SHA-256 is 7D5D4C324BE85A865F01FFCD999C206F346AA338DE1261F38FB94AD3CF3DB90D. LICENSE.txt now also lists @marijn/find-cluster-break, a dependency of @codemirror/state that every build of the bundle has included. The build recipe and the bundle's export list are kept outside the embedded frontend, in tools/codemirror/BUILD.md, entry.js and package.json.

Dinah's Editor (editor-codemirror.js for the theme, editor-applet.js for the rest) adapts the CodeMirror setup of the Parks Computing editor, js/editor.js, read on 10 October 2026 with SHA-256 C657FE8B47DBC795BA287AC56540D08CA3137ACF9615B862AF8E229CDC8A5536: its theme built from PUDL's colour tokens, its editing extensions and its key binding rules. The editor's site file system, tabs, explorer, settings file and server preview are not used; the Editor works on Dinah's drafts instead.
